cards.name: Word Processor In
cards.summary: Text types on character by character behind a blinking cursor, like typing in a word processor; the default speed is fast (about 27 characters per second), so a short line is typed almost instantly.
use_for: Search-bar or chat-prompt style text in an AI channel
avoid: Cursor blink expression (Math.tan) runs for the whole layer
Progress counts characters and ends at 55: text longer than 55 characters stays cut off unless the last Progress key is raised

Hindi/Devanagari (measured 2026-10-13): per-character animators split dependent vowel signs (matras) from their consonants mid-animation, though the settled text shapes correctly; for Hindi animate per word or per line (Range Selector Based On: Words or Lines, or a By Word / By Line preset)
cards.duration_note: Keyframes start at comp.time and run to +2 s (the Progress slider is keyed 0 to 55 characters, about 27 characters per second; all three selectors use Index units driven by it). Cursor blink is expression-driven and keeps running. Times read from the .ffx keyframes; retime by scaling the keyframes. Render check (applied at 0 s): the 12-character test line was fully typed before +0.5 s and no cursor showed at 0.5 s or 1.4 s; for a visible type-on, move the last Progress key so the speed suits the text length.
cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the planned in-point, make the text layer the only selected layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<batch 'file' path>)). Needs a TextLayer (comp.layers.addText); on a non-text layer the text animators cannot be added. Adds Slider Controls whose names start with a TAB: "\tProgress" (drives the reveal, in characters) and "\tCursor Blink Rate" (4). Set the last Progress key to the text's character count (spaces included) and move it to set the typing speed; never rename the controls.

verified.note: Both frames are pixel-identical to the plain text with no cursor visible: the 12-character test line is fully typed by about +0.44 s, before the first sample.

cards.name: Zippy In
cards.summary: Lines zip in from about 800 px to the left one after another (top line first), skewing hard as they arrive and overshooting with a small bounce before stopping, all within about 1.1 s.

avoid: Skew wobble reads as cartoony on serious content

cards.name: Counter Countdown Monospaced
cards.summary: Turns the text layer into an animated number counter driven by the 'Counter Countdown Controls' pseudo effect; by default it counts down ('Animate Value' keyed 100 to 0 over 1.5 s) with monospaced digit spacing so the number does not jitter.
use_for: Statistic count-up in an explainer (votes, crores, percentages)
Election results or seat tally in a news package
avoid: By default the typed text is hidden ('Show Original Text' = Hide Original Text); set it to Before Numbers or After Numbers to keep a prefix or suffix such as '%' or ' seats'
Only 3-digit grouping formats (1,234,567.01 / 1.234.567,01 / 1 234 567,01), and separators are off by default: no Indian lakh/crore grouping
Large values need the '10x Value Multiplier' control: check the first and last frame
cards.duration_note: Keyframes start at comp.time and run to +1.5 s ('Animate Value' of the 'Counter Countdown Controls' pseudo effect is keyed 100 to 0). Times read from the .ffx keyframes; retime by scaling the keyframes.
cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the planned in-point, make the text layer the only selected layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<batch 'file' path>)). Needs a TextLayer (comp.layers.addText); on a non-text layer the text animators cannot be added. Adds the pseudo effect '\tCounter Countdown Controls' (leading TAB in the name; match name 'Pseudo/ADBE Counter Controls', batch name 'Counter Controls'). Property indices: 1 Animate Value (keyed), 2 10x Value Multiplier (2; the expressions use powers of ten of value-1), 3 Pad Zeros (4), 4 Digits After Decimal (0), 7 Number Format (1 '1,234,567.01', 2 '1.234.567,01', 3 '1 234 567,01'), 8 Show Original Text (1 Before Numbers, 2 After Numbers, 3 Hide Original Text; preset 3), 11 Show Group Separators (off), 12 Group Spacing, 13 Group Separator Offset, 14 Align Group Spacing (1 Left, 2 Right, 3 Center). Set start/target by editing the two Animate Value keys (effect(1).property(1)). Source Text is expression-driven.

verified.note: The layer shows a zero-padded counter counting down: 0484 at 0.5 s, 0009 at 1.4 s.

cards.name: Currency Counter Monospaced
cards.summary: Turns the text layer into an animated currency counter driven by the 'Currency Counter Controls' pseudo effect: it rolls up ('Animate Value' keyed 0 to 100 over 1.5 s) with a $, EUR, JPY or GBP symbol, group separators, 2 decimals and monospaced digits.
use_for: Dollar, euro or pound figures in an AI-business or tech video (funding, valuations)
Market or price figures in a news package (non-INR)
Indian budget amounts only with a separate rupee-sign text layer
avoid: No rupee option: 'Currency Symbol' offers only $ USD, EUR, JPY and GBP. For INR use a separate text layer with the rupee sign, or Counter Countdown Monospaced with 'Show Original Text' = Before Numbers (verify)
No Indian lakh/crore grouping (formats are $1,234,567.01 / 1.234.567,01 $ / 1 234 567,01 $)
Source Text is expression-driven: typed text is replaced
